changes: The week view looks like a paper planner: two columns with one cell per day and its events, and an overview of the hours of the week in the eighth cell. Tap beside the events of a day, or on a free hour of the overview, to create an event
In the month view, an event is lower in its day for a later time, the days of the months before and after are darker, and today stands out
Change the calendar of an event in the editor
Move a calendar chip with a long press and a drag: the chips keep their new order
The hatched patterns show again behind the text of events, with fainter lines there
36 colors for categories and tasks
The clock follows the 24-hour setting of the phone until you choose one in the Grit settings
Drag a task by its handle onto another category to move it there
The lines of the hatched and cross-hatched patterns stop around event titles and times, so that the text stays readable
Events without a category are grey instead of the theme color
Each calendar has a pattern in the views (solid, outline, hatched, dashed, dotted or cross-hatched), so calendars differ while colors show categories
A row of calendar chips under the views shows or hides each calendar and the tasks, and shows their patterns
Choose the pattern of each calendar in the calendar settings
Settings > Sync server also holds the calendars of the server: show them, stop syncing, export them, add one by URL, or start syncing a calendar of this device
The calendar settings keep the calendars of this device, the categories and the import
Export a calendar as an .ics file for other calendar apps
Rename an event category, and see which calendars use each category
The sync server is in the settings: Settings > Sync server holds the CalDAV account and the task lists
Removing the account keeps its calendars and task lists on this device, and they stop syncing
Connecting the same server again, even at a new address, syncs them again with the changes made meanwhile
The calendar settings screen links to the sync server page
The tasks widget follows the setting "Reorder tasks when marked as completed"
About shows the app and its license only, with a link to this version's source code
Settings and About show the version of this build
